---
title: "Visualizing the Paired t-Test Assumptions with Normal and Exponentially Distributed Data"
name: "Anthony Morciglio"
date: "11/07/2025"
output: html_document
---

## Introduction

In this section, we validate the **normality assumption** required for the *paired t-test* using two datasets: one generated from a normal distribution and another from an exponential (non-normal) distribution.  

The **paired t-test** assumes that the *differences between paired observations* are approximately normally distributed.  
We will:
1. Generate paired samples (normal and exponential),
2. Perform the paired t-test,
3. Conduct the Shapiro–Wilk test for normality,
4. Visualize the differences using a histogram and Q–Q plot.

---

```{r, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# Set random seed for reproducibility
set.seed(123)

# Generate paired data
n <- 30
x_norm <- rnorm(n, mean = 50, sd = 10)
y_norm <- x_norm + rnorm(n, mean = 2, sd = 5)

x_exp <- rexp(n, rate = 0.1)
y_exp <- x_exp + rexp(n, rate = 0.1)

# Compute differences
diff_norm <- y_norm - x_norm
diff_exp  <- y_exp - x_exp

# Perform paired t-tests
t_norm <- t.test(x_norm, y_norm, paired = TRUE)
t_exp  <- t.test(x_exp, y_exp, paired = TRUE)

# Shapiro-Wilk test for normality
shapiro_norm <- shapiro.test(diff_norm)
shapiro_exp  <- shapiro.test(diff_exp)

# Print results
cat("Paired t-test (Normal Data):\n")
print(t_norm)
cat("\nShapiro-Wilk Test (Normal Differences):\n")
print(shapiro_norm)

cat("\n--------------------------------------\n")

cat("\nPaired t-test (Exponential Data):\n")
print(t_exp)
cat("\nShapiro-Wilk Test (Exponential Differences):\n")
print(shapiro_exp)

# Load plotting library
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)

# Create histogram plots for both distributions
hist_norm <- ggplot(data.frame(diff_norm), aes(x = diff_norm)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = ..density..), bins = 10, fill = "blue", color = "black") +
  geom_density(color = "darkblue", size = 1) +
  ggtitle("Histogram of Differences (Normal Data)") +
  xlab("Difference") + ylab("Density") +
  theme_minimal()

hist_exp <- ggplot(data.frame(diff_exp), aes(x = diff_exp)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = ..density..), bins = 10, fill = "red", color = "black") +
  geom_density(color = "maroon", size = 1) +
  ggtitle("Histogram of Differences (Exponential Data)") +
  xlab("Difference") + ylab("Density") +
  theme_minimal()

# Create Q-Q plots for both distributions
qq_norm <- ggplot(data.frame(sample = diff_norm), aes(sample = sample)) +
  stat_qq(color = "blue") + stat_qq_line(color = "black") +
  ggtitle("Q-Q Plot (Normal Data)") + theme_minimal()

qq_exp <- ggplot(data.frame(sample = diff_exp), aes(sample = sample)) +
  stat_qq(color = "red") + stat_qq_line(color = "black") +
  ggtitle("Q-Q Plot (Exponential Data)") + theme_minimal()

# Arrange plots for visual comparison
grid.arrange(hist_norm, hist_exp, qq_norm, qq_exp, ncol = 2)
```
